tweets.text: $4 billion pulled from spot Bitcoin ETFs in June — the worst month since they launched. BlackRock's IBIT saw its first-ever net outflows. When the biggest players start heading for the exits, that's not a dip. That's institutional capitulation.
AI startups raised $120B+ in H1 2026. Crypto VC? About $15B. That's an 8:1 ratio starving crypto of growth capital. CZ says the money didn't disappear — it just found a shinier object.

US-Iran tensions ease, stocks rally, and Bitcoin… drops. The "digital gold" hedge narrative just broke in real time. When risk-on lifts everything except crypto, the headwinds are coming from inside the house.

Framework Ventures is betting crypto's next chapter isn't crypto at all — it's financing robots, data centers, and energy grids. Tokens and DAOs as infrastructure funding vehicles. The most interesting crypto thesis right now barely mentions coins.
